title: Banning the Banished: Levels 1 & 2
description: Banning the Banished: Levels 1 & 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the golded farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag and slay the Banned Farmers. Also, collect 15 Golded Pumpkins and 30 Golded Ears o' Corn then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

You did a great job with the previous quests, but somehow iVan is still pumping out Banned Farmers to farm the golded vegetables. We need you to continue to banish them back to where they came from if we want to stand a chance of returning the economy to normal.

The report I have before me says that the farms on Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, and Level 2 are all infested and need to be cleared out again. Also, we have been unable to figure out how to transmute the vegetables back to their original state, so we need you to collect more golded vegetables for our testing. When you have banned the farmers and collected the required vegetables return to me, Yakov Smearnov, in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Well done! Oh, wait a moment. It looks like they are back already. Let me know when you want to head out again.

Objectives:

  • Farm on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Farm on Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Farm on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Golded Pumpkins ×15
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×30

Client level range: 78–100
